We’d love to help you find “the one” for your space! Here are a few ways to narrow things down:

Go Custom: Our Custom by Rugs USA rugs are cut to fit your space, up to 12' x 27".
Measure first: Finalize your furniture layout, measure with a tape, and even map the rug size with painter’s tape on the floor to be sure of the fit.
Try samples: For many Custom by Rugs USA styles, you can order 12" x 12" samples (about 3–5 business days to arrive) so you can see color and texture in your home before committing.
Color expectations: Our photos aim to be very accurate, but since many rugs are handmade, slight color and pattern variations can happen, and patterns may change by size.
Add a rug pad: We strongly recommend a non‑slip rug pad to keep your rug in place, add a bit of cushion, and help reduce wear.

If you tell us your room (living room, bedroom, etc.), size, and style or color vibes, we can talk through what might work best based on this guidance.
